description_en: Deletes one or more rules from an account group. You can delete a rule in the Cloud Config console. After you delete the rule, the configurations of the rule are deleted
description_zh: 删除指定账号组内的规则。删除规则后，其配置信息不再保留
kebab_example: aliyun config delete-aggregate-config-rules --config-rule-ids cr-4e3d626622af00800000 --aggregator-id ca-a4e5626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAggregateConfigRules

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of the account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

OperateRuleResult.description_en: The results of the delete operations

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned.

If the rule is deleted, no error code is returned.
If the rule fails to be deleted, an error code is returned. For more information about error codes, see Error codes (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。

当您删除规则成功时，该参数为空。

<props="china">- 当您删除规则失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误中心 (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)。</props>

<props="intl">- 当您删除规则失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误中心 (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)。</props>
